text: Imagine that a copy of the platform's database leaves the bank on a stolen disk.
prefix: Imagine that a copy of the platform's database leaves the bank on a stolen disk.

text: The thief opens the table with Aziz's verified identity.
prefix: The thief opens the table with Aziz's verified identity.

text: What can he read?
prefix: What can he read?

text: In Lesson 16, the platform kept Aziz's verified identity after one full proofing, with the reusable identifier from MyID next to it.
prefix: In Lesson 16, the platform kept Aziz's verified identity after one full proofing, with the reusable identifier from MyID next to it.

text: This lesson shows how that record is protected: who holds its keys, who may read it, and how every read leaves a trace.
prefix: This lesson shows how that record is protected: who holds its keys, who may read it, and how every read leaves a trace.

text: First, what counts as protected.
prefix: First, what counts as protected.

text: The verified identity, in all its versions: names, date and place of birth, the personal identification number, gender, citizenship, nationality, document data and registered addresses.
prefix: The verified identity, in all its versions: names, date and place of birth, the personal identification number, gender, citizenship, nationality, document data and registered addresses.

text: The phone number that MyID gave.
prefix: The phone number that MyID gave.

text: The reusable identifier, and its expiry date.
prefix: The reusable identifier, and its expiry date.

text: And the images from the camera, but only if the bank turns image storage on.
prefix: And the images from the camera, but only if the bank turns image storage on.

text: Nothing else lives in this class.
prefix: Nothing else lives in this class.

text: Phone numbers, devices and network addresses are personal data too, but other rules handle them.
prefix: Phone numbers, devices and network addresses are personal data too, but other rules handle them.

text: Now the keys.
prefix: Now the keys.

text: Each identity record has its own data key.
prefix: Each identity record has its own data key.

text: The record is encrypted with that key, and the key itself is stored only in wrapped form, locked by the installation key.
prefix: The record is encrypted with that key, and the key itself is stored only in wrapped form, locked by the installation key.

text: The installation key never leaves the bank's Vault.
prefix: The installation key never leaves the bank's Vault.

text: When the platform must read the record, it sends the wrapped key to Vault, gets it unwrapped for that one request, and forgets it when the request ends.
prefix: When the platform must read the record, it sends the wrapped key to Vault, gets it unwrapped for that one request, and forgets it when the request ends.

text: No part of the system keeps a decrypted copy longer than the request, and the identity never goes to a log.
prefix: No part of the system keeps a decrypted copy longer than the request, and the identity never goes to a log.

text: So the thief with the disk reads only ciphertext, and a wrapped key that he cannot open.
prefix: So the thief with the disk reads only ciphertext, and a wrapped key that he cannot open.

text: But then, how does the platform find Aziz by his personal identification number, without decrypting every row?
prefix: But then, how does the platform find Aziz by his personal identification number, without decrypting every row?

text: With a blind index.
prefix: With a blind index.

text: Next to the record, the platform keeps a keyed digest of the number, made with a second key from Vault: the index key.
prefix: Next to the record, the platform keeps a keyed digest of the number, made with a second key from Vault: the index key.

text: To find a person, it makes the same digest and looks it up.
prefix: To find a person, it makes the same digest and looks it up.

text: It is fast, it allows one active customer for each number, and without the index key the digest tells the thief nothing.
prefix: It is fast, it allows one active customer for each number, and without the index key the digest tells the thief nothing.

text: Inside the gateway, only one module may touch this table: the identity module.
prefix: Inside the gateway, only one module may touch this table: the identity module.

text: Every other module asks it.
prefix: Every other module asks it.

text: And it answers with masked values, unless the purpose is on a short list.
prefix: And it answers with masked values, unless the purpose is on a short list.

text: Here is that list.
prefix: Here is that list.

text: Keeping a new proofing result.
prefix: Keeping a new proofing result.

text: The confirmation screen, on the device of the session that gave the result.
prefix: The confirmation screen, on the device of the session that gave the result.

text: The phone check.
prefix: The phone check.

text: The customer lookup, with the personal identification number only.
prefix: The customer lookup, with the personal identification number only.

text: A case or a phone review, with masked values only.
prefix: A case or a phone review, with masked values only.

text: A compliance export, when a customer asks for his own data.
prefix: A compliance export, when a customer asks for his own data.

text: The deletion job.
prefix: The deletion job.

text: And a verified address, when Aziz approves a sharing request.
prefix: And a verified address, when Aziz approves a sharing request.

text: Now look at the other side: who never gets it.
prefix: Now look at the other side: who never gets it.

text: The bank's apps get only an identity summary, with the level and the display name, but no personal identification number, no document number, no address and no image.
prefix: The bank's apps get only an identity summary, with the level and the display name, but no personal identification number, no document number, no address and no image.

text: The bank's antifraud system, the notifications and the audit trail never get it.
prefix: The bank's antifraud system, the notifications and the audit trail never get it.

text: And a different app never gets it, except the address that Aziz chose to share.
prefix: And a different app never gets it, except the address that Aziz chose to share.

text: Every release is an audit event, with the reader and the purpose.
prefix: Every release is an audit event, with the reader and the purpose.

text: Last month, an operator opened a case about Aziz.
prefix: Last month, an operator opened a case about Aziz.

text: She saw only masked values: the first two and last two digits of his number, and the last four characters of his document.
prefix: She saw only masked values: the first two and last two digits of his number, and the last four characters of his document.

text: The audit trail recorded her, the purpose, and the time.
prefix: The audit trail recorded her, the purpose, and the time.

text: I think this line matters more than the encryption.
prefix: I think this line matters more than the encryption.

text: Encryption stops the thief with the disk, and the audit line stops the person who already has access.
prefix: Encryption stops the thief with the disk, and the audit line stops the person who already has access.

text: It also means that a later phase can show Aziz who read which data, when, and why.
prefix: It also means that a later phase can show Aziz who read which data, when, and why.

text: One more rule keeps the history honest.
prefix: One more rule keeps the history honest.

text: Identity data changes only through a refresh, which is a new full proofing.
prefix: Identity data changes only through a refresh, which is a new full proofing.

text: A refresh writes a new version, and keeps the old one for the configured retention time.
prefix: A refresh writes a new version, and keeps the old one for the configured retention time.

text: The personal identification number is the same in every version of one customer.
prefix: The personal identification number is the same in every version of one customer.

text: To recap: one protected class, a key for each record, the installation key in the bank's Vault, a blind index for search, one module at the door, masked reads by default, and an audit event for every release.
prefix: To recap: one protected class, a key for each record, the installation key in the bank's Vault, a blind index for search, one module at the door, masked reads by default, and an audit event for every release.
